limitations: Base-model calibration does not measure a training gain.
Confidence intervals cluster four responses by independent instance; pilot intervals can be wide.
Coverage, resource shapes and tool transitions are diversity proxies; structural held-out performance is reported separately.
Sampling predictions must be validated on fresh training instances; no held-out outcome was used to fit weights.
stage: Frozen eight-domain baseline; untrained target-model calibration
meaning_of_diversity: Effective counts measure coverage. Resource shapes and attempted tool transitions are design/interaction proxies; attempted transitions include failed actions. Held-out results are descriptive base capability, not a learned-model transfer gain.
quality_gaps: Code, science and mathematics cannot reach a predicted mean of 0.5 with the baseline cells and coverage floors.
Media and security have substantial formatting failures; reward variation must be separated from interface friction.
Finance has only 2/8 mixed groups among groups with valid JSON and no budget failures despite a pooled mean close to 0.5.
No training gain measured; the redesigned candidate and a trained-versus-base pilot require fresh evaluation.
